panels.title: ECS351 Architectural Evaluation: Event-Driven Push (SSE) vs Client Polling (5s)

options.content: ### Architectural Trade-off Study: Event-Driven vs. Polling - **Architectural Difference Tested**: Push (Server-Sent Events backed by in-process EventBus) vs. Pull (Client interval polling every 5 s). - **Color Encoding**: Event-Driven (Blue) vs. Polling (Orange) across all panels. - **How to Read a Load Step**: Always read steady-state values from the **middle flat section** of each step (e.g. 10, 50, 100, 200, 400 clients), avoiding ramp-up or ramp-down spikes. - **Baseline Textboxes**: Enter the lowest-load (10 clients) p95 ingest latency in `$base_event` and `$base_polling` (in ms, default: 5) to calculate degradation %.
